sloka: पश्य मे मुद्गरं घोरं सर्वकालायसं महत्।अनेन निर्जिता देवा दानवाश्च पुरा मया ।। ६.६७.१३७ ।।
transliteration: paśya me mudgaraṁ ghoraṁ sarvakālāyasaṁ mahat।anena nirjitā devā dānavāśca purā mayā ।। 6.67.137 ।।

translations.english: Raghava's eyes turned red with anger, went quickly in anger as monkeys and troop leaders oppressed by Kumbhakarna were rejoiced.
